records.title: PointSplat: Compact Gaussian Splatting via Human-Centric Prediction
records.reason: PointSplat is a compact 3D human Gaussian-splatting reconstruction method, unrelated to LLM inference despite FlashAttention lineage.

records.title: FaceMoE: Mixture of Experts for Low-Resolution Face Recognition
records.reason: FaceMoE uses routed experts for low-resolution face recognition; the generic MoE lineage does not make it LLM inference work.

records.title: Illuminating Unified Multimodal Model for Free-form Interleaved Text-Image Generation
records.reason: Primary arXiv abstract describes interleaved text-image generation quality/modeling and contains no LLM inference efficiency contribution.

records.title: DAIN: Dynamic Agent-Based Interaction Network for Efficient and Collaborative Multimodal Reasoning
records.reason: DAIN is a multimodal classification/regression fusion model; it does not optimize LLM inference or generative serving.

records.title: The FIL Hypothesis: Inductive Biases Help with Kernel Engineering
records.reason: The paper applies inductive-bias prompting to LLM-generated GPU kernels, which is adjacent to kernel optimization, but improves kernel-writing workflow rather than the LLM inference runtime itself.
